subject.title: Fix MSTeams card actions with durable receive before ACK

question: Should this PR wait for live Microsoft Teams tenant validation, or should an authorized maintainer explicitly override the external-PR real-behavior proof gate for this head?
rationale: The implementation and automated evidence are strong, but only a tenant holder can verify the Bot Framework ACK and proactive replay behavior that creates the message-delivery risk.

options.title: Run tenant validation
options.body: Have a Teams tenant holder run the six documented scenarios on the rebased head and post redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording.

options.title: Explicit proof override
options.body: An authorized maintainer may accept the remaining delivery risk based on the SQLite lifecycle tests, SDK-contract review, and green CI.

options.title: Pause pending access
options.body: Keep the PR open without merge until a suitable Teams development tenant becomes available.

recommendation.title: Run tenant validation
recommendation.body: Have a Teams tenant holder run the six documented scenarios on the rebased head and post redacted logs, terminal output, or a recording.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor requested validation from them directly, and they are the clearest available owner for deciding whether tenant proof is required or overridden.
